claim_boundary.allowed: turns the current checklist and handoff manifest into an ordered real-run recipe
claim_boundary.not_allowed: does not provide extracted files, measured values, accepted evidence, or analog replacement proof

manual_write_forbidden: accepted-post-layout must be written only by scripts/submit_converter_post_layout_payload.py

recipe_steps.action: Choose one converter layout for the 10-bit DAC input and 12-bit ADC readout target.
recipe_steps.name: choose_converter_layout
recipe_steps.proof_object: one named converter macro, extracted view, or silicon measurement object

recipe_steps.action: Produce an inspectable extracted circuit file and place it under the candidate netlist folder.
recipe_steps.name: extract_post_layout_circuit
recipe_steps.proof_object: extracted SPICE, DSPF, SPEF, or equivalent extracted circuit artifact

recipe_steps.action: Place process model files or measurement setup records under the candidate models folder.
recipe_steps.name: collect_run_models_or_measurement_setup
recipe_steps.proof_object: model deck, corner include, parasitic include, or measurement setup record

recipe_steps.action: Use one non-placeholder run id for the whole post-layout or measured-silicon run.
recipe_steps.name: run_one_named_experiment

recipe_steps.action: Record energy, latency, noise, area, voltage, temperature, and process or measured condition from that same run.
recipe_steps.name: record_physical_values
recipe_steps.proof_object: numbers tied to the extracted converter or measured silicon object

recipe_steps.action: Keep the fixed DAC, ADC, noise, and sharing boundary unless the break-even model changes too.
recipe_steps.name: check_fixed_boundary

recipe_steps.action: Rerun the break-even calculation with extracted or measured values and place the source rerun JSON under the candidate rerun folder.
recipe_steps.name: rerun_break_even

recipe_steps.action: Fill payload.json, remove template_only only after all placeholders and file paths are real, then run readiness.
recipe_steps.name: fill_candidate_payload
recipe_steps.proof_object: candidate payload ready for strict preflight

recipe_steps.action: Submit only after readiness reports ready for strict submission.
recipe_steps.name: strict_submit_only_if_ready
recipe_steps.proof_object: accepted post-layout rerun and submission report written by the strict command
